About / Connect

PLAYER PROFILE
CREATOR PROFILE // 1TRVNE

SO, WHAT IS 1TRVNE?

I'm Coltrane. Cars were one of my first creative outlets, and over time I started connecting that passion to everything else I enjoy — making videos, music, graphic design and telling stories.

1TRVNE is where I put all of that together. It's a place to create without boxing myself into one lane. I want the work to feel like something I'd actually play, watch, or listen to.
